related.title: 艾達芙拉太陽能電廠
related.transfer: 可遷移「用地與功率密度」與「雙面模組的量測」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；艾達芙拉太陽能電廠的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Land use and power density" and "Measuring a bifacial module" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Al Dhafra Solar PV Plant must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦讓模組的背面也發電：背面輻照度、雪地增益、扭力管遮蔭、白色地布與量測方法；艾達芙拉太陽能電廠則以單一場址兩百萬瓩的光電廠：雙面模組的背面增益、模組數量與創紀錄的電價為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on making the back of a module generate too: rear irradiance, gain over snow, torque-tube shading, white ground cover and measurement; Al Dhafra Solar PV Plant centres on A two-gigawatt plant at a single site: rear-side gain of bifacial modules, module count and a record tariff, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年發電量與性能比」與「年發電量與性能比」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「排距與冬至遮蔭」的模型移到艾達芙拉太陽能電廠，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「I–V 曲線與填充因子」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Annual yield and performance ratio" and "Annual yield and performance ratio".
Move the model of "Row pitch and winter-solstice shading" to Al Dhafra Solar PV Plant, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "I–V curve and fill factor", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「用地與功率密度」與「雙面模組的量測」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；艾達芙拉太陽能電廠的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Land use and power density" and "Measuring a bifacial module" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Al Dhafra Solar PV Plant must be respecified.

related.title: 太陽能追日機構與控制
related.transfer: 可遷移「用地與功率密度」與「雙面模組的量測」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；太陽能追日機構與控制的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Land use and power density" and "Measuring a bifacial module" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Solar Tracker Mechanisms and Control must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦讓模組的背面也發電：背面輻照度、雪地增益、扭力管遮蔭、白色地布與量測方法；太陽能追日機構與控制則以讓整排模組跟著太陽轉：追日增益、回溯避影、風扭矩、馬達功率與角度誤差為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on making the back of a module generate too: rear irradiance, gain over snow, torque-tube shading, white ground cover and measurement; Solar Tracker Mechanisms and Control centres on turning whole rows to follow the sun: tracking gain, backtracking, wind torque, motor power and angle error, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年發電量與性能比」與「年發電量與性能比」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「排距與冬至遮蔭」的模型移到太陽能追日機構與控制，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「驅動馬達的功率」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Annual yield and performance ratio" and "Annual yield and performance ratio".
Move the model of "Row pitch and winter-solstice shading" to Solar Tracker Mechanisms and Control, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Power of the drive motor", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「用地與功率密度」與「雙面模組的量測」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；太陽能追日機構與控制的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Land use and power density" and "Measuring a bifacial module" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Solar Tracker Mechanisms and Control must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 雙面模組與反照率發電增益
history.titleEn: Bifacial Modules and Albedo Energy Gain
history.text: 2019 年雙面模組量測的技術規範發布；2019 年雙面追日試驗場開始量測；2023 年兩百萬瓩級的雙面電廠啟用。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2019: The technical specification for measuring bifacial modules was published. 2019: The bifacial tracking field began measurements. 2023: A two-gigawatt bifacial plant opened. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
